data.narrative:
Focused Energy is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Thomas Forner and Markus Roth, having raised $240M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 11 total peers: 3 public entities (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms spanning seed through Series B stages, including Valar Atomics, Nano Nuclear Energy, and Fuse Energy.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $240M total raised as a baseline proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage advancement, implying $480M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $808M (range: $200M to $6.0B), with Fuse Energy at $200M, Nano Nuclear Energy at $808M, and Valar Atomics at $6.0B representing the distribution width.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $408M (low) to $929M (high), with a median of $644M. The wide dispersion in the peer set—particularly the $6.0B outlier (Valar Atomics, Series B)—reflects significant stage and investor risk heterogeneity within frontier nuclear. Key uncertainties include technology risk differentiation within the peer cohort, capital intensity of commercialization pathways, and whether the $240M raised proxy accurately reflects market-implied value rather than cash deployed.
